# cron-utils

> Validate, explain and preview cron schedules in one Go import
> (github.com/ofershap/cron-utils), plus a small CLI. Five and six field
> expressions with extensions (L, W, #, ?, names, steps). Typed errors name
> the bad field and why, so agent output can be fed straight back to the
> model. English descriptions and next-N occurrence previews. Standard
> library only, no dependencies.

## Usage

- Library: s, err := cronutils.Parse("0 9 * * FRI#3"); s.Describe() returns English; s.NextN(from, n) previews occurrences.
- CLI: cron-utils "0 9 * * 1-5" prints "At 09:00 AM, Monday through Friday".
- Bad input returns *cronutils.ParseError with field, offending text and a plain message.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ofershap/cron-utils#readme): install, syntax coverage, examples, Q&A
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ofershap/cron-utils): library API
